name: Misterio77 nix-config
summary: Flake-based NixOS and home-manager setup with Hyprland and generated colors.
description: Misterio77's whole infrastructure as a Nix flake: NixOS and home-manager configurations for his desktop, laptop and servers, with a heavily configured Hyprland and a pure-Nix Material You color engine. It also sets up impermanence, encrypted Btrfs partitioning with disko, Secure Boot and sops-nix secrets, so it is a reference to learn from rather than something to switch to as it is; the author suggests his starter config for beginners.
